evidence.detail: title() returns a plain string with no emoji/symbol stripping
<title>{{title}}</title> — Mustache HTML-escapes but does not strip emoji
og_title() returns self.deck.name which can contain emoji (e.g. Stop That ✋)
og_title() and og_description() similarly return raw strings with no stripping

triage.fix_sketch: Add a `strip_unsafe_chars(s: str) -> str` utility in `decksite/view.py` that removes characters whose Unicode category starts with 'S' (Symbol) or 'So' (Other Symbol) — this strips emoji while preserving CJK, Greek, Cyrillic, etc. Call it in `View.title()` before returning, and optionally wrap the base-class `og_title()`/`og_description()` (or document that subclasses should call it). Total ~20 lines across `decksite/view.py`.
triage.notes: The issue author explicitly approved the simple Unicode-category-based approach as a first pass; the font-aware approach is a possible later refinement.
